products.title: ATTACK SHARK C06 ULTRA Coiled Cable For Mouse
products.body_html:
Next-Gen Aesthetic with RGB LED Glow

The C06 ULTRA redefines desk style with synchronized LED breathing lights at both Type-C and USB connectors. The soft, gradient glow perfectly complements your gaming peripherals, creating an immersive esports atmosphere that reacts to your setup's heartbeat.

Metal Aviator Connectors

The C06 ULTRA custom coiled mouse cables's splices use high-quality metal connectors, providing superior resistance to oxidation and interference, making the connection stable even after prolonged use and multiple unplugging. It will add texture to your desk setup and make your mouse look awesome!

Premium, Durable and Tangle Resistant

Uses four high-quality copper wires and aluminum shielding foil as the core, the USB-C coiled mouse cable is not afraid of bending or breaking. It also uses a new TPU material, a low-key luxury, beautiful and not easy to lose shape.

Professional Reversed Coil

Through our intensively developed cable coiling process, we use a professional way to reverse coil. As a result, we have created a super-tight 20mm "springy" coils that has a significant rebound effect and and more substantial, which effectively prevents damage caused by overstretching.

Metal Aviation Connector & High Speed Charging

With Heavy-Duty Metal 4-Pin Detachable Aviator cable Connector, allows you to quickly attach different cables to your mouse or other accessories. Supports safe fast charging and data sync. Type-C interface design, perfectly meet all USB-C mouse powered and connect needs.

Easy to use length & Excellent Quality

The C06 ULTRA coiled cable consists of two parts, the total length measures approximately 52 inches, extendable up to 70 inches. It also has undergone numerous technical tests including data transmission stability, heavy load test on connect and swing test. Each product you have got is high quality.

products.title: Pre Order: ATTACK SHARK R86 HE Carbon Fiber Rapid Trigger Keyboard Magnetic Switch
products.body_html:
• Forged Carbon Fiber & CNC Aluminum Build

  • Featuring a premium Forged Carbon Fiber Composite top case paired with precision CNC-machined aluminum accents. This advanced construction combines a sleek, futuristic aesthetic with excellent durability, giving the R86 HE a distinctive high-end look and solid feel for both competitive gaming and everyday setups.

  • Extreme 8000Hz Polling & 0.08ms Latency

  • Built for tournament-grade responsiveness, the R86 HE delivers an ultra-fast 8000Hz polling rate and just 0.08ms latency. Every keystroke is transmitted with near-zero delay, giving competitive players the speed and responsiveness needed for fast-paced FPS and esports gaming.

  • 0.005mm RT, Snap Tap & Adjustable Actuation

  • Powered by advanced Hall Effect technology, the R86 HE delivers ultra-precise 0.005mm Rapid Trigger accuracy. Fine-tune every key with adjustable actuation while taking advantage of Rapid Trigger and Snap Tap for faster resets, rapid directional changes, and precise control in competitive gameplay.

  • HUANO Glass Jade Magnetic Switch

  • Equipped with HUANO Glass Jade Magnetic Switches, the R86 HE delivers smooth, consistent keystrokes with the precision and responsiveness of Hall Effect technology. Combined with fully adjustable actuation and Rapid Trigger functionality, every key can be tuned to match your preferred gaming style.

  • Immersive RGB Backlighting & Dual-Zone Side Strips

  • Create a more immersive gaming setup with fully customizable per-key RGB backlighting. Dual-zone RGB side strips add an extra layer of ambient lighting around the keyboard, creating a clean underglow effect that enhances the overall look of your desktop.

  • 80% Layout with 81-Key Practical Design

  • The R86 HE features a streamlined 80% layout with 81 keys, offering a practical balance between compact size and everyday functionality. Dedicated arrow keys and essential navigation controls remain within easy reach, while the reduced footprint leaves more room for mouse movement without sacrificing the familiar functionality of a larger keyboard.

  • Refined Typing Sound & 5-Layer Acoustic Stack

  • Engineered with a 5-layer sound-dampening structure, the R86 HE reduces hollow resonance and unwanted case noise for a cleaner, more refined typing sound. Combined with HUANO Glass Jade Magnetic Switches and its carefully tuned internal construction, it delivers a solid and satisfying acoustic experience with every keystroke.

  • Seamless Dual-Mode Software & On-Board Memory

  • Customize the R86 HE through either the web-based driver or desktop software, with access to actuation distance, Rapid Trigger, Snap Tap, RGB lighting, macros, and other advanced settings. Built-in on-board memory stores your configurations directly on the keyboard, allowing your preferred settings to stay with you without constant software adjustment.

  • 52g ULTRA-LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN

  • Weighing just 52±3g, the V2 AIR is built for quick flicks, effortless repositioning, and smooth control without unnecessary weight. Its lightweight construction works together with the refined ergonomic shape to help reduce fatigue and maintain comfortable control through extended gaming sessions.

  • OMRON OPTICAL SWITCHES

  • Built for speed, consistency, and durability, Omron optical microswitches provide crisp, responsive actuation with a lifespan rated for up to 100 million clicks. A TTC Gold scroll wheel encoder complements the main switches with precise, defined scrolling for reliable control across gaming and everyday use.

  • TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY & FULL CUSTOMIZATION

  • Switch between high-performance 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired connections to adapt the V2 AIR to different devices and setups. Fine-tune DPI, polling rate, button assignments, macros, and other performance settings through the web driver or dedicated PC software.

  • GLASS-FEEL ICE COATING

  • Finished with a smooth Glass-Feel Ice coating, the V2 AIR delivers a refined, premium touch designed for comfortable and consistent handling. Its 124 × 68 × 39 mm body combines a supportive rear profile with a controlled waist, balancing natural hand support with the agility needed for fast gaming.

products.body_html:

Fine-tune the optical sensor position across 5 levels to match your grip style and hand movement. Research shows the optimal sensor position can reduce path deviation by up to 23% and improve speed & accuracy by up to 14%, helping you achieve more consistent aim.

  • The innovative magnetic battery module allows quick one-step battery replacement. Equipped with dual batteries, you can swap batteries anytime to eliminate power anxiety.   • Built with a carbon fiber composite injection-molded shell featuring precision hollowed-out areas, RS6 ULTRA achieves an ideal balance between structural strength and weight reduction. The premium construction delivers durability while maintaining an ultra-light gaming experience.

  • Powered by a deeply customized PixArt PAW3955MAX sensor, RS6 ULTRA delivers up to 52,000 DPI, adjustable in 1 DPI increments. Featuring 5-level adjustable LOD, you can fine-tune lift-off distance for your preferred tracking style and competitive advantage.

  • Ultra Wireless Technology — Dual 8KHz Performance

  • Equipped with ATTACK SHARK’s self-developed wireless transmission technology, RS6 ULTRA supports 8000Hz polling rate over 2.4GHz wireless and wired connections. Experience ultra-low click latency as low as 0.168ms for instant response in intense battles.

  • Nordic 54L15 MCU — High-Speed Processing Power

  • Powered by the latest Nordic 54L15 MCU, RS6 ULTRA supports up to 20,000 FPS static scan rate, ensuring accurate tracking performance, faster signal processing, and stable competitive-level control.

  • Premium Mechanical Feel — Optical Switches & CNC Metal Wheel

  • Equipped with Omron optical switches rated for 100 million clicks, delivering fast actuation and exceptional durability. The CNC-machined metal scroll wheel features anodized finishing and a TTC gold encoder for a premium tactile experience.

  • Glass-Feel Ice Coating — Smooth Control, Less Sweat

  • The specially developed glass-feel ice coating creates a smoother surface texture while reducing sweat buildup during long gaming sessions. Maintain consistent grip and precise control even during intense gameplay.

  • Integrated SHARK 8K Receiver — Wireless + Charging Hub

  • The redesigned SHARK 8K receiver combines wireless connectivity and battery charging in one compact device. Enjoy a cleaner desktop setup while keeping your spare battery ready whenever you need it.

products.title: ATTACK SHARK R98 HE Carbon Fiber Rapid Trigger Keyboard Magnetic Switch
products.body_html:
• Ultra-Responsive Performance | 8000Hz & 0.08ms Low Latency

  • Dominate the Game with Lightning Speed: Engineered for competitive gaming, the R98 HE features a blistering 8000Hz polling rate and an ultra-low 0.08ms latency. Powered by customized Ice Shark Magnetic Switches, it registers actions instantly, giving you a distinct competitive edge in fast-paced FPS and rhythm games where every millisecond counts.

  • Next-Gen Precision | 256kHz Scan Rate & 0.005mm RT

  • Revolutionary Rapid Trigger Tech: Driven by a breakthrough 256kHz scan rate, experience zero-deadzone precision with a 0.005mm adjustable Rapid Trigger (RT). Enjoy instantaneous key resets and flawless micro-adjustments for perfect counter-strafing and ghost-free execution.

  • Premium Carbon Fiber Craftsmanship & Esthetics

  • Aerospace-Grade Durability & Visual Splendor: Stand out with a premium Carbon Fiber Composite Top Case paired with exclusive Forged Carbon Fiber/PBT keycaps and a rigid aluminum alloy positioning plate. Complemented by a custom RGB Lightbox and full RGB backlighting, this keyboard delivers a sleek, futuristic, and high-tech gaming aesthetic.

  • Ultimate "Thocky" Sound & Hot-Swappable Customization

  • Acoustic Perfection Meets Versatility: Featuring a 5-layer sound dampening stack, the R98 HE eliminates hollow echoes to produce a deep, clean, and satisfying "thocky" typing sound. The fully hot-swappable PCB offers multi-switch compatibility, allowing you to easily swap and customize switches to match your exact typing preference.

  • Seamless Control & Dual Driver Flexibility

  • Intuitive CNC Knob & Advanced Web Software: Take command with the dedicated CNC multimedia knob for on-the-fly volume and media control. Fine-tuning your performance is effortless with Dual Driver Support—choose between convenient web-based configuration or downloadable software to remap keys, adjust RT settings, and customize RGB profiles perfectly.

products.title: ATTACK SHARK RS3 ULTRA Carbon Fiber Wireless PAW3955MAX Gaming Mouse with C06 Ultra LED Cable

• PAW3955MAX Gaming Sensor & Nordic 54L15 MCU

Equipped with the Nordic 54L15 MCU, it provides 20,000 FPS tracking performance and up to 0.168ms response time, ensuring ultra-fast processing, stable wireless transmission, and low-latency gameplay.

  • Tri-Mode Connectivity & Shark-Fin RGB 8000Hz Receiver

  • Enjoy seamless switching between 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired modes with support for multiple devices. The Shark-Fin RGB receiver displays battery level, DPI, polling rate, and more in real time. Experience up to 8000Hz polling in wired and 2.4GHz modes, plus 133Hz Bluetooth, ensuring responsive performance for gaming and everyday productivity.

A CNC-machined metal scroll wheel with a textured anti-slip surface, paired with a TTC Gold encoder, delivers precise tactile feedback, smooth scrolling, and consistent control for every game.

Finished with a premium Glass-Feel Ice Coating, it delivers a cool, smooth touch that enhances grip, comfort, and control while reducing hand fatigue during extended gaming sessions and competitive play.

  • Driverless Web Control & C06 Ultra Coiled Cable

Onboard memory stores your profiles for plug-and-play convenience across devices. products.body_html:
Premium Stable Connection & Fade-proof Hub Design

The C08 cable adopts a high-precision 4-pin steel aviation plug for ultra-stable data transmission without signal loss. Equipped with a custom anodized aluminum alloy hub controller, it features excellent oxidation resistance and permanent colorfastness, maintaining a brand-new texture for long-term gaming use.

Magnetic Control RGB Ambient Lighting

The C08 aviation cable supports synchronized RGB gradient breathing light and multi-color static lighting on dual tail lines and Type-C ports. With convenient magnetic light switching, it creates a dynamic and immersive esports atmosphere, perfectly matching personalized desktop gaming setups.

Pure Copper Core for Full 8K High-speed Performance

Built with pure copper wire cores and professional transmission optimization, the C08 cable greatly reduces data delay and signal interference. It stably supports 8KHz high polling rate output, delivering ultra-fast and responsive gaming performance for competitive gameplay.

Dual Type-C 8K Multi-mode Connection System

Featuring a unique one-to-two dual Type-C structure, the C08 cable supports full 8K transmission speed on both ports. It flexibly adapts to dual wired mode, dual 2.4G wireless mode, or mixed wired + wireless connection for keyboard and mouse, realizing multi-device high-speed linkage.

Fully Reinforced Injection Locking

As an upgraded durable design, the C08 aviation plug, USB port, Type-C port and hub port all adopt exclusive internal injection locking technology. It effectively enhances bending and swing resistance for longer service life.

products.body_html:

  • Universal Compatibility & High-Speed Charging

  • Equipped with a high-performance Type-C interface, the C01 ULTIMATE supports safe fast charging and seamless data transfer across all USB-C keyboards and devices. Every cable undergoes rigorous swing and load tests to ensure "Ultimate" reliability from the moment you plug it in.

products.title: ATTACK SHARK G6 Tri-mode Gaming Mouse
products.body_html:
Three connection methods

G6 mouse has 3 connection methods. Wired mode, just plug in the Type-C cable to connect. Bluetooth mode, just turn on the Bluetooth of the mouse and click on the computer to connect. 2.4G mode, just plug the USB receiver into the host to connect. A variety of connection methods meet your different needs.

10 Buttons

As a professional gaming mouse, it has 10 buttons, which is very convenient for various operations. Such as separate fire button, desktop button, web button and light button. PLEASE NOTE: This mouse has no driver software and cannot program the buttons.

Cool Lighting

The light-emitting mouse has 11 RGB lighting modes, and unlike other RGB mice, we specially designed a light control button, you no longer need to turn over the mouse button to switch the light. Next to the right mouse button is the light switching button. 11 different lighting effects will light up your game world.

Mechanical Appearance

This mechanical mouse is carefully crafted by professional design masters. Dozens of proofs have been made for both appearance, shape and color matching. The final appearance of the mecha is cool and stylish, taking you on a sci-fi world.

Rechargeable Battery

The wireless mouse has a built-in 500mAh rechargeable lithium battery. It takes about 3-4 hours to fully charge. Energy-saving and low-power consumption technology is adopted, and it can be used for several weeks on a single charge. products.title: ATTACK SHARK X87 ULTRA Wireless Gaming Keyboard with 8KHz Receiver and RGB Coiled Cable
products.body_html:
Triple-Mode Connectivity & 8KHz Speed with Ultra-Low Latency

Supports Bluetooth, 2.4G wireless, and wired connections. Both 2.4G and wired modes deliver 8KHz polling rates, while the hot-swappable socket allows easy switch replacement. A custom high-performance chip ensures smooth operation, and full-key rollover is standard. The fin-shaped 8K wireless receiver achieves just 0.125ms latency for a truly responsive experience.

Custom Meg Shark Switches & Factory-Tuned Stabilizers

Features custom Meg Shark Gateron Linear Switch with built-in light guides for vibrant illumination. The stabilizers are factory-lubed and meticulously tuned with balanced wires to eliminate rattle, providing snappy rebound and consistent feel on large keys.

Plate-Spring Gasket Structure & High-End PCB Build

Adopts a plate-spring Gasket structure with multiple lateral Gasket mounts, plus a 5-layer sound-damping system (PORON foam, IXPE pad, PET sheet, DEPDM foam, custom silicone base) to eliminate hollowness and deliver a HiFi acoustic experience. The FR4 1.2mm dual-layer black PCB features single-key slotting—a thousand-yuan-level build—along with a slotted PC translucent plate for superior flexibility and comfort.

 Immersive RGB Lighting, Side Strips & DIY Dot-Matrix Screen

Comes with 16 million-color RGB LEDs and 22 dazzling presets, plus side RGB light strips switchable via shortcut keys. South-facing LEDs enhance keycap compatibility. A dot-matrix screen lets you DIY custom patterns and animations for personalized visual flair.

 Premium Keycaps & Massive 10,000mAh Battery

Includes full-series OEM-height PC transparent UV-printed keycaps and forged carbon fiber keycaps. Powered by a massive 10,000mAh battery, it delivers up to 5,000 hours of use with lighting turned off for exceptional endurance.

Web Driver & Thoughtful Accessories

Supports a web-based driver for easy customization without software installation. Comes with a steel wire switch/keycap puller, two extra switches, three additional keycaps (black translucent and white translucent), and a 1.5-meter Type-C cable with a magnetic ring for stable data transmission.

8000Hz RGB Cable & Dynamic RGB Effects

Designed for pro gamers, the C01 Ultra RGB coiled cable delivers an 8000Hz polling rate for instant response and fluid gameplay. It features 16 million RGB colors with over 20 backlighting effects, plus RGB light strips on both sides, creating an immersive lighting experience that enhances esports performance and elevates any gaming setup.

products.title: ATTACK SHARK K85 Rapid Trigger Keyboard Magnetic Switch
products.body_html:
82 Keys ANSI Layout & Double-shot PBT Keycaps

This compact TKL keyboard features the popular 75% layout, striking the perfect balance between functionality and compactness. Unlike a 60% or full-sized keyboard, it preserves essential keys while optimizing desk space. In addition, made with high-quality PBT material, the keycaps promise durability, resisting the oily shine that can develop over time.

Adjustable Actuation Point

The K85 keyboard is equipped with fully adjustable OUTEMU Hall magnetic switches, enabling you to set every key’s actuation point from 0.2mm to 3.8mm in 0.1mm steps. This puts you in control for lightning-fast keypresses or ultra-accurate typing. You can also use the key combination FN+1~4 to switch between Comfort, Sensitive, Game, and Custom modes.

Rapid Trigger Tech

Rapid Trigger removes any delay caused by the physical movement of the switch. Instead of relying on a fixed actuation point like traditional mechanical keyboards, it immediately activates and deactivates the key with minimal travel. This allows for seamless, continuous keystrokes, giving players a critical advantage in FPS and rhythm games like Valorant and osu!

Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS)

Assign up to four distinct actions to a single key based on the depth of your press. For example, lightly press a key to walk forward in a game, and press deeper to run. The key release also supports two-stage settings. This enables smoother, personalized command combinations that can give you an edge in competitive gaming.

Deadzone Setting & On-board Memory

The Deadzone represents a non-triggerable key travel area. Customize the bottom deadzone to match your typing style and preferences for more precise releases. With on-board memory, your settings are stored directly on the hardware. There's no need to keep the software running—just plug and play on a new PC with your saved profiles and enjoy the games.

Gasket Mount & Gorgeous RGB

The K85 features a gasket mount system, a sought-after design in the mechanical keyboard world. To better suit the gasket mount, the K85 has a PC plate that is more responsive than regular steel plates, producing pleasing typing sounds. The RGB backlit keyboard has 18 built-in RGB modes and 9 colors, all of which can be customized through the driver software.

Important Reminder

Hall sensors are sensitive to temperature variations, which can cause significant changes to the magnetic field during transportation. After receiving the keyboard, we recommend calibrating it manually in the software by going to 'About - Maximum stroke calibration - Start calibration'. (Driver Software: www.qmk.top)

products.title: ATTACK SHARK X6 Three Modes Gaming Mouse With Charging Dock
products.body_html:
49G SUPER LIGHT

X6 ultra-light mouse is born for players who pursue extreme weight. Through the innovative liquid nitrogen cooling injection molding, the weight of the mouse is reduced to 49g. It is 30% lighter than G PRO X and 20% lighter than Aerox 3, allowing players to move the mouse faster during game operations, speeding up the operation, and reducing the fatigue caused by long-term use.

CHARGING DOCK

Simply place your X6 mouse on the base and it's always charged and ready for any adventure. Magnetic design, convenient and fast. There is also a touch switch on the charging base, which can switch the lighting effect by touching it.

3395 GAMING SENSOR

The X6 Gaming Mouse is equipped with the latest PixArt 3395 flagship sensor, with a DPI of up to 26,000 and can be adjusted in 6 levels. Whether you use it for daily work or professional gaming, X3 can easily meet your needs.

BK3633 TRI-MODES

In order to meet the needs of different scenarios, the X3 high-performance mouse is equipped with a BK3633 chip, providing three different connection modes, wired USB-C, 2.4GHz and Bluetooth mode, which can be easily switched through the button on the back of the mouse.

80 MILLION CLICKS

The ultra-long-life mouse is equipped with KAILH GM8.0 Micro Switch 3 Pin. Releasing force 25gf(min), Operating force 65±10gf, Conduction itinerary 0.3±0.2mm, Touch feeling 25%. Gold plated contacts. No double click. The click life is more than 80 million times and can be used for decades.

200 HOURS BATTERY

The X6 rechargeable mouse is equipped with a super long battery life. It takes about 2-3 hours to fully charge. After simulating the test of normal usage scenarios, it can be used for up to 200 hours at intervals on a single charge. Long battery life can help you play various games for a long time.

TTC ENCODER

The X6 mouse wheel adopts a TTC encoder, which has been deeply optimized, debugged and calibrated, making the hand feel crisper, the rebound faster, and the sense of scale is very strong. It is suitable for FPS games, allowing you to switch guns one step faster than the enemy.

SELF-DEVELOPED DRIVER

The X6 professional gaming mouse has an independently developed driver software. DPI adjustment, return rate, custom macro button programming and other settings can be performed. Allows you to release combined skills with one click and become a master player in seconds.

ERGONOMIC DESIGN

Different from the honeycomb shell mouse, X6 does not punch holes in the shell to reduce weight. This is because X3 needs to provide the most comfortable hand feeling in consideration of the different postures of holding the mouse, such as fit grip, finger grip, grip, etc.

WIDE APPLICABILITY

X6 ultra-light mouse is widely applicable to multiple operating systems, such as win7/8/10/11/Mac/Android/Xbox. If you encounter any problem, please feel free to contact our staff, we will solve your problem within one working day.
